channel.title: LC Insight
channel.description: Read the chain, not the rumors. Crypto market news and on-chain analysis.

item.title: Bitway (BTW) bounces 32% in a day, but it is still 84% below its October record
item.description: BTW climbed from a low near $0.335 late Monday to about $0.45 on Tuesday evening, after falling more than 60% in a week. A PancakeSwap pool on BNB Chain carried half the trading.

item.title: Rain (RAIN) has given back 40% since Monday's peak, and HTX carried half the trading
item.description: RAIN topped out near $0.0079 early Monday, November 16, then slid to about $0.0048 by Tuesday evening. Only about $20 million traded against a market value of $3.4 billion.

item.title: Brevis (BREV) doubled in a day from a record low, and 37% of the trading ran through Upbit
item.description: BREV hit an all-time low near $0.0554 on Monday night, then ran to about $0.132 by Tuesday morning. It is still about 80% below its January record.

item.title: Rumor vs record: Hyperliquid Strategies applied for a U.S. futures license. It has not got one
item.description: Posts say the Nasdaq-listed HYPE holder got a U.S. futures license after a $620.6 million quarter. We checked each line against its own SEC filing. It applied. It has not been approved.

item.title: SM7d72 holds $88 million in Ether and bitcoin shorts, $19.2 million up on paper
item.description: The No. 3 trader on DeepSea's 7-day board has a $47.6 million Ether short at 25x and a $40.4 million bitcoin short at 40x, plus $55 million in USDC.

item.title: Sharks sold $37.6 million in 24 hours: one wallet dumped $9.5 million of Aave USDC
item.description: DeepSea's 24-hour shark feed shows sells outweighing buys by 3 to 1. The biggest sells are dollar tokens, plus $4.6 million of a Circle-linked token.

item.title: Smart money wallet SMd4f8 is $3.66 million down on a $6.91 million HYPE short
item.description: The No. 12 trader on DeepSea's 7-day board shorted Hyperliquid's HYPE token near $32.46. HYPE now trades near $69, so the bet is deep under water.

item.title: Injective jumps 12% to $7.48 with no confirmed cause. INJ is still 86% below its record
item.description: INJ was one of CoinGecko's trending coins on November 17 with a 12% daily gain. We checked the numbers and found no official announcement that explains it.

item.title: More bitcoin went onto exchanges than left: net 1,387 BTC in a day, and Binance took 2,479
item.description: DeepSea's exchange flow panel shows 20,536 BTC in and 19,148 BTC out. Kraken, Bitfinex and OKX lost coins while Binance and Bybit gained.

item.title: Marc Zeller's Hyperliquid wallet made $126,600 in a week, two thirds of its 30-day profit
item.description: DeepSea ranks the wallet No. 6 on its KOL board. It moved $1.70 million of volume, holds little else, and shows no flags in DeepSea's risk database.

item.title: A shark with 81,000+ trades a month just bought $6 million of RLUSD, 99% of its basket
item.description: DeepSea's shark Hold91cc swapped into 18 tokens within one minute on Ethereum. Only one was big: Ripple's dollar stablecoin.

item.title: Smart money wallet SM54b0 is all short: $36.5 million in bets, $12.1 million up on paper
item.description: The No. 9 trader on DeepSea's 7-day board has ten open Hyperliquid shorts and no long positions. Together they show about $12.1 million of paper profit.

item.title: Solana ETFs took in $11.7 million on Monday, the most since September, as SOL fell 11%
item.description: U.S. spot Solana funds broke a month of selling on November 16, CoinMarketCap data show. XRP funds saw no net flow, and XRP slipped below $1.

item.title: One shark sold $4.64 million of a Circle stock token worth $8 million in all
item.description: One trade by a wallet down $2.93 million in a week was worth more than half of rCRCL's total market value. Another losing shark sold $1.66 million of a SpaceX stock token.

item.title: Two top-10 traders are short $117.7 million of bitcoin and ether, up $26.6 million on paper
item.description: SMdfdb and SM7da2 sit No. 6 and No. 8 on DeepSea's 7-day board. One holds a $55 million ether short from $2,283, the other a $56.3 million bitcoin short from $78,440.

item.title: HYPE jumped 6% with top traders 91% short. The biggest short is $17.9 million in the red
item.description: DeepSea counts $286.5 million of HYPE shorts against $26.8 million of longs among 63 top Hyperliquid traders. The biggest bet against HYPE, opened near $28.79, shows a $17.9 million paper loss.

item.title: The top two traders' accounts shrank $206 million in two days, and $29.5 million left Aave
item.description: SMc060 and SM6e36 still lead DeepSea's 7-day profit board, but the assets DeepSea lists for them fell from $230.8 million to $24.6 million. On Arbitrum, their wallets pulled $29.5 million of USDC out of Aave in a day.

item.title: Backpack's BP jumped 48% in two hours, then gave back a fifth. Most volume hit Solana pools
item.description: BP went from about $0.84 at 4 p.m. ET to about $1.25 at 6 p.m. ET on Monday, CoinGecko data show, and sat near $1.00 after midnight. Daily volume rose about elevenfold.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs bled $1.79 billion over eight straight outflow days as bitcoin slid to $65,000
item.description: U.S. spot bitcoin funds had net outflows of $185.4 million on Friday and $66.9 million on Monday, CoinMarketCap data show. It is their longest outflow run in the 63 sessions CoinMarketCap's 90-day chart covers.

item.title: Lighter's LIT rose 28% from Monday's low, above its price before the $10.4 million loss
item.description: LIT traded at $3.00 early Tuesday, CoinGecko data show, about 9% above where it stood before Lighter froze withdrawals. Daily volume is about four times its pre-incident level.

item.title: PayPal's PYUSD shrank $269 million in a day and is down 22% from its October 27 peak
item.description: PYUSD's market value fell 10.2% in 24 hours to $2.38 billion, CoinGecko data show, the biggest one-day drop of any top-30 stablecoin. The price held at $1.

item.title: Bless (BLESS) more than doubled in a day, and it is still 91% below its 2025 record
item.description: BLESS climbed from about $0.0090 to a peak near $0.0194 in 15 hours on Monday, with a single PancakeSwap pool carrying about 41% of the trading.

item.title: One leaked API key cost a Lighter trader about $10.4 million. Lighter froze all withdrawals
item.description: Lighter says a single trader's leaked API key, not a bug in its contracts, let an attacker pull about $10.4 million in USDC on November 16, 2026. On-chain trackers show the money swapped to ether and sent to Hyperliquid.

item.title: Longs paid on 84% of HYPE futures bets on Friday. Now shorts pay on 61%
item.description: HYPE slipped 7.7% in a week to $66.91, and $280 million of its futures bets closed. On Hyperliquid itself traders still pay to bet on a rise, while Binance, Bybit and OKX now show negative funding.

item.title: Lighter's LIT fell 13% in a day. Shorts now pay on 76% of its $237 million in futures bets
item.description: LIT tops CoinGecko's trending list after a 13% drop to $2.61. Futures traded eight times its spot volume, and open bets on Lighter's own LIT market fell 44% in five days.

item.title: Rumor vs record: MARA's $1.1 billion bitcoin sale came before the crash. 5 claims checked
item.description: Monday's most shared posts said MARA dumped $1.1 billion of bitcoin into the slide, that bitcoin is deeply oversold and that big holders face record losses. MARA's own filing and CoinGecko's price records show three claims hold up, one is misleading and one cannot be checked.

item.title: Ether ETFs lost $2.19 billion in 34 trading days, erasing all their late-summer inflows
item.description: U.S. spot ether funds had outflows on 29 of 34 trading days from September 29 to November 13, CoinMarketCap data show. Over 90 days they are now net sellers.

item.title: USD1 has shrunk 15 days in a row. $833 million is gone since November 1
item.description: World Liberty's dollar token fell from $3.87 billion to $3.04 billion on CoinGecko, now below where it started 2026, while it still trades about $1 billion a day.

item.title: BlackRock's BUIDL shrank 24% in a month and now ranks fourth. Circle's USYC lost 15%
item.description: The two big institutional Treasury tokens lost roughly $900 million between them in 30 days, rwa.xyz data show, while Ondo's USDY grew.

item.title: Ethena's USDtb lost a third in 12 days. USDe added $349 million in one day
item.description: Two steps took USDtb from $484 million to $318 million on CoinGecko. Its sister token USDe jumped $349 million in a single reading, then went flat.

item.title: Influencer mk4 made $4.66 million in a week. The $13.4 million Zcash short is gone
item.description: DeepSea now ranks the KOL first on its 7-day board. A week ago mk4 held a big Zcash short; now it bets against ether, bitcoin and Monero and sits mostly in cash.

item.title: Trader SMeb17 has $2.5 million, made $4.31 million in a week and holds $17.6 million of shorts
item.description: DeepSea's SMeb17 is short $12.59 million of ether and $4.97 million of bitcoin on Hyperliquid, about seven times its assets. On Arbitrum, the same address put 1,031 staked ether into Aave.

item.title: Trader 'John Wick' made $13.1 million in a week and is short $59.8 million of bitcoin
item.description: DeepSea ranks the Hyperliquid trader No. 5 on its 7-day smart money board. The bitcoin short, opened near $74,700, shows a $9.3 million paper gain, while most big traders DeepSea tracks are long.

item.title: Rain (RAIN) jumped 43% in about an hour overnight, and it is still 74% below its August record
item.description: RAIN climbed from about $0.0036 to $0.0052 between 12:50 and 1:55 a.m. ET on thin trading, with BingX carrying more than half of the day's volume.

item.title: Solana ETFs lost $136.7 million in four weeks with only one inflow day
item.description: U.S. spot Solana funds saw money leave on 14 of 20 trading days from October 19 to November 13, CoinMarketCap data show. XRP funds lost $19.1 million last week.

item.title: Jito's staked SOL shrank by 289,349 tokens in a month as its price fell 31%
item.description: JitoSOL, Jito's liquid staking token on Solana, ended Sunday at 7.87 million tokens, CoinMarketCap data show. Supply fell on most days of the selloff.

item.title: Kelp's rsETH lost 10% of its supply in a month. Rocket Pool's rETH fell 3.6%
item.description: About 37,900 rsETH tokens were redeemed or burned between October 15 and November 15, CoinMarketCap data show, as ether fell a quarter. Ether.fi's weETH held steady.

item.title: Lido's stETH grew by 87,688 ETH in a month as ether fell 25%
item.description: Holders kept staking through the selloff. Lido's staked ether token reached 9.75 million on Sunday, CoinMarketCap data show, with more than half of the month's growth in the last week.

item.title: Coinbase's cbBTC added 7,185 bitcoin in a week as bitcoin fell 13%, closing in on WBTC
item.description: The supply of Coinbase's wrapped bitcoin token rose to 102,692 by Sunday evening, CoinMarketCap data show. That is about $468 million of new tokens in seven days, and it is closing in on WBTC.

item.title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin's '3-month low' was its lowest since July. 5 weekend claims checked
item.description: Weekend headlines said bitcoin broke $64,000, hit a three-month low and XRP sank to its lowest since 2024. We checked five of them against CoinGecko's price records. Three hold up, one is only partly checked, one cannot be checked.

item.title: Bitcoin sat flat at $64,749 on Sunday after a 13% weekly drop, and Zcash lost 28%
item.description: Bitcoin moved just 0.1% in 24 hours as the crash paused. The seven-day damage stayed deep across the top coins, with Zcash, Uniswap and Pepe down a quarter or more. Quant led the small Sunday bounce.

item.title: Solana Mobile's SKR jumped 41% in 10 hours, and Korea's Upbit did half the trading
item.description: Seeker, the token tied to Solana Mobile, rose from under 1 cent to $0.0122 on Sunday night as daily trading roughly quadrupled. Korean won markets on Upbit and Bithumb carried most of it.

item.title: EVAA is up 142% in two days, and $60 million traded in a token worth $18 million
item.description: The lending token on TON and BNB Chain climbed from $1.10 to $2.67 since early Saturday, with 24-hour trading 3.4 times its market value. Only 13% of its supply circulates, and it is still 80% below its 2025 record.

item.title: Aster (ASTER) jumped 25% in 55 minutes on Sunday, then lost all of it in 15
item.description: ASTER rose from about $0.551 to $0.691 between 3:15 and 4:10 p.m. ET on November 15, then fell to $0.503 by 4:25 p.m. ET. It is now 79% below its record.

item.title: Bitway (BTW) falls another 27% in a day and is now 81% below its October record
item.description: BTW slid from about $0.72 to a low near $0.50 in 24 hours, its second steep daily drop this week, on only about $9.3 million of trading.

item.title: Meme coin Macca the Gator is up 272% in a day, and all of its trading runs through one Uniswap pool
item.description: MACCA, an Ethereum meme token whose CoinGecko price history starts at 2 p.m. ET on November 14, rose from about $0.0046 to a record $0.0190 on Sunday. It is on CoinGecko's trending list.

item.title: Meme coin AudaCity jumped 260% in 90 minutes after an 85% slide, and it trades in one Uniswap pool
item.description: AudaCity (DACITYCOIN), a five-day-old Ethereum meme token, crashed 85% from its record over two days, then rose from $0.0042 to $0.0152 in 90 minutes on Saturday afternoon, November 14. It is up 248% in 24 hours and No. 2 on CoinGecko's trending list.

item.title: Meme coin Gato The Cat jumped 39% in a day and tops CoinGecko's trending list, all in one Uniswap pool
item.description: GATO, a cat-themed Ethereum token whose CoinGecko price history starts on Saturday, November 14, rose 39% in 24 hours to Sunday, November 15, while bitcoin fell 1.8%. Every trade CoinGecko tracks ran through a single Uniswap pool.

item.title: Meme coin Identity.md jumped 43% in a day as bitcoin fell, all through one Uniswap pool
item.description: IMD, an Ethereum meme token with about one day of price history on CoinGecko, rose from about $0.0111 to $0.0159 in 24 hours to Sunday, November 15, and is No. 1 on CoinGecko's trending list. Bitcoin fell 2.0% over the same day.

item.title: Bitcoin has never lost two years in a row. It needs a 34% jump in 46 days to avoid it
item.description: Bitcoin closed 2025 at $87,509 on CoinMarketCap, down 6.3% for the year. At about $65,500 on Sunday, November 15, 2026, it is down 25% in 2026. CoinMarketCap's daily record since 2013 shows every losing year followed by a gain.
